scripts.start: cross-env RUST_BACKTRACE=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 NODE_OPTIONS=--trace-uncaught concurrently -k "cross-env NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=none yarn react-start" "wait-on http-get://localhost:3000/static/js/bundle.js && electronmon ."
scripts.build: yarn cargo:clean && yarn neon && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.build-mac-x64: yarn cargo:clean && yarn neon-mac-x64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.build-mac-arm64: yarn cargo:clean && yarn neon-mac-arm64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.build-win-x64: yarn cargo:clean && yarn neon-win-x64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.build-win-arm64: yarn cargo:clean && yarn neon-win-arm64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.test:run: yarn neon && cross-env CI=true node scripts/test.js --watchAll=false
scripts.neon: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-mac-x64: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-mac-arm64: rimraf src/native.node && LZMA_API_STATIC=1 cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-win-x64: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon-win-arm64: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon:wcash-regtest: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --release --no-default-features --features wcash-regtest --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.neon:wcash-regtest:mac-arm64: rimraf src/native.node && LZMA_API_STATIC=1 cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --locked --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --no-default-features --features wcash-regtest --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.build:local-regtest-qa:mac-arm64: yarn verify:upstream-ui-parity && yarn neon:wcash-regtest:mac-arm64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.package:local-regtest-qa:mac-arm64: yarn verify:wcash-candidate-policy && node scripts/assert-wcash-local-regtest-qa-package.js && rimraf dist/local-regtest-qa && yarn rebuild:keytar:local-regtest-qa:mac-arm64 && yarn build:local-regtest-qa:mac-arm64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.local-regtest-qa.json --mac zip --arm64 -c.extraMetadata.main=build/electron.js --publish never
scripts.neon:wcash-regtest:linux-x64: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --locked --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --no-default-features --features wcash-regtest --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
scripts.build:local-regtest-qa:linux-x64: yarn verify:upstream-ui-parity && yarn neon:wcash-regtest:linux-x64 && cross-env node scripts/build.js
scripts.package:local-regtest-qa:linux-x64: yarn verify:wcash-candidate-policy && rimraf dist/local-regtest-qa/linux-x64 && yarn rebuild:keytar:local-regtest-qa:linux-x64 && yarn build:local-regtest-qa:linux-x64 && electron-builder --config config/electron-builder.local-regtest-qa.linux-x64.json --linux AppImage deb --x64 -c.extraMetadata.main=build/electron.js --publish never
scripts.neon:wcash-regtest:windows-x64: rimraf src/native.node && cargo-cp-artifact -a cdylib zingolib-native src/native.node -- cargo build --locked --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-default-features --features wcash-regtest --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --message-format=json-render-diagnostics
